summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a small Regulation D/S private placement of 89,128 Class I shares for $869,000, finalized September 23, 2026, plus monthly distributions of $0.074775 gross per Class S/D/I share payable October 30 and November 30, 2026. The company also updated its continuous public offering, with roughly $4.07 billion raised across classes. No special-situation transaction is present; these are routine capital-raising and distribution disclosures with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms.
